page-title.purpose: Top-level page identifiers. One per view.

heading.purpose: Section headings and stat cell values.

title.purpose: Panel headings and invoice numbers in detail view.

body.purpose: Form labels, descriptions, and ledger item names. Max line length 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Section bar titles, eyebrow labels, role tags. Always uppercase.

caption.purpose: Timestamps, metadata notes, and detail notes.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Default on cards and panels. Barely perceptible structural separation.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Auth card only. Single focal element floats above the page.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all interactive state transitions.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Button, nav, and input state transitions.

motion.name: duration-chart
motion.purpose: Trend bar height animation. Uses cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for exponential ease-out.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The sole saturated element in any default view. Used for the primary action on each screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.58 0.14 28); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: oklch(0.58 0.14 28); color: oklch(0.99 0.005 75); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.52 0.14 28); border-color: oklch(0.52 0.14 28); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.22 0.008 75 / 0.04); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.58 0.14 28 / 0.08); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral bordered button for secondary actions like New, Refresh, and Finalize.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.008 75); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: oklch(0.99 0.004 75); color: oklch(0.22 0.008 75); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: oklch(0.78 0.012 75); background: oklch(0.945 0.01 75); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.22 0.008 75 / 0.04); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.58 0.14 28 / 0.08); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent button for tertiary actions like export format selection and line item removal.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.42 0.008 75); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.955 0.008 75); color: oklch(0.22 0.008 75); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.58 0.14 28 / 0.08); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action button for delete operations. Alert Ember on tinted background.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.55 0.16 25 / 0.15); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: oklch(0.55 0.16 25 / 0.08); color: oklch(0.55 0.16 25); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(0.55 0.16 25 / 0.14); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.55 0.16 25 / 0.12); } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input for text, date, and number fields. Focus ring uses Fired Clay.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.42 0.008 75); font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.008 75); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: oklch(0.99 0.004 75); color: oklch(0.22 0.008 75); font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.58 0.14 28); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.58 0.14 28 / 0.08); } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.58 0.006 75); }

narrative.overview:
Fintrack's interface channels the feeling of high-quality stationery: warm cream paper, crisp ink, no clutter. Every surface carries the quiet authority of a well-kept ledger. The system is built for a Malaysian small business owner seated at a desk during business hours, working on a standard monitor in a well-lit office. That scene demands a light mode with warm, low-chroma neutrals that read clearly under natural and fluorescent light.

The system explicitly rejects generic SaaS dashboards with big gradient numbers and icon grids; overly playful consumer-app aesthetics with rounded everything and pastel confetti; and cluttered legacy accounting software that exposes every possible field on one screen. If someone can guess the palette from the category name alone, the design has failed. Fintrack breaks that reflex with warm stone neutrals and a single fired-clay accent that reads more like architecture than banking.
keyCharacteristics: Light mode, warm-tinted neutrals throughout; never pure white, never pure black
Single accent color (Fired Clay terracotta) used sparingly on primary actions and active states only
Numbers as primary content: tabular-nums, high-weight, prominent positioning
Structure through spacing and weight, never through gradients, glows, or ornamental borders
Flat by default; shadows appear only as structural hints, never as decoration

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Fired Clay is the only saturated color at rest on any screen. Its presence means 'act here.' If a second saturated color appears at rest, the hierarchy breaks.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every achromatic value carries chroma 0.004-0.012 at hue 75. Pure #000 and #fff are prohibited. This is what makes surfaces feel like paper instead of screens.

rules.name: The Scale Ratio Rule
rules.body: The type scale follows a 1.2 ratio (minor third): 0.75 > 0.875 > 1 > 1.2 > 1.44 > 1.728. Fixed rem steps, not fluid.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every monetary value renders with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns of numbers align vertically without layout shift. Non-negotiable for financial data.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow Small is so subtle it's more texture than elevation. If a shadow is visible enough to cast a floating impression, it's too heavy.

dos: Do use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every monetary value.
Do tint every neutral toward hue 75 with chroma 0.004-0.012. Paper, not screen.
Do keep Fired Clay under 10% of any screen's surface area.
Do use tonal layering (page > card > inset) to convey depth before reaching for shadows.
Do pair color status indicators with text labels.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion with a blanket transition-duration: 0.01ms override.
Do keep section bar titles uppercase, tracked, and in Driftwood Tertiary.
Do use consistent 150ms ease-out timing on all interactive state transitions.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't apply background-clip: text with a gradient.
Don't use glassmorphism, backdrop-filter, or blur effects.
Don't build hero-metric templates (big gradient number, small label, sparkline).
Don't create identical card grids with icon + heading + text.
Don't use display or serif fonts in UI labels, buttons, or data fields.
Don't introduce a second saturated color at rest.
Don't use em dashes in UI copy.
Don't apply the navy+gold, dark-blue+teal, or any other category-reflex finance palette.
